name: Jewel Pearl
paragraphs: Jewel Pearl is located at Azad road near Jawaharlal Nehru stadium , Kaloor. It is just a km away from Mathrubhumi Junction in the National Highway 47 on Kaloor- Palarivattom road. name: Jewel Bay View
paragraphs: Located near the Chilavanoor lake,amid the vibrant city of Vyttila, 'Bay View' is a luxury project from 'Jewel Homes'. 100 water front apartments located in 2 towers overlooks the Chilavanoor lake. These dream homes located in 2 towers at Janata road is at close proximity to the Toc-H school in Vyttila . Laden with all world class amenities and infrastructure this signature project calls for a towering presence in the vicinity.Our craving for security and comfort leads us to dream for a home - A Home for Ever.
Bay View satisfies this dream for a well designed home imbibing the ambience of the lakeside while taking advantage of the prominence of its location.

name: Jewel River Woods
caption: The city in your palm
paragraphs: These ready to occupy apartments are endowed with all modern amenities . The 56 three bed room apartments spread across 14 floors captures the beauty of the serene 'Periyar' tucked in the heart of Aluva. Located behind the 'Seemas Wedding Centre" Riverwoods captures all the easiness and advantages of the town life while imbibing the freshness and the placidity of this famed riverside. Aluva has been the most preferred suburb of the elite of the society from time immemorial. A well equipped gym, club house, roof top party area, river view point with park benches and community area for recreation makes it (cherry on the topping ) stand tall in the town of Aluva.

Today, the city of Cochin is wooing the world with her vibrant beauty and resources. For investors, it's a place of ever growing opportunities, for a home maker, it's a cosmopolitan city that unfolds amenities of matchless life styles, knowledge and learning.
